---
title: "Reuse reviewed individual panels: main Figure 1 and Supplementary Figure 1"
format: html
editor: source
---

No redesign, route extensions or statistical refits. Reuses the v6 individual
sources with already staged Treatment terminology and obsolete-note removal.
Earlier `figure1_analysis_and_s1_experiment.qmd` is unexecuted and superseded.

```{r}
out <- commandArgs(TRUE)[[1]]; stopifnot(!dir.exists(out)); dir.create(out,recursive=TRUE)
base <- "/Users/shaman.narayanasamy/Work/data/phage_uv_treatment/PRJEB79569/derived/figure1_promoted_workflow_2026-09-15-v3/sources"
file.copy(file.path(base,"workflow_metro.svg"),file.path(out,"Figure1-analytical-workflow.svg"))
scope <- function(doc,prefix) {
 t <- as.character(doc)
 classes <- unique(unlist(strsplit(xml2::xml_attr(xml2::xml_find_all(doc,"//*[@class]"),"class")," ")))
 for(cl in classes[!is.na(classes)]) t <- gsub(paste0("\\.",cl,"(?=[^A-Za-z0-9_-])"),paste0(".",prefix,cl),t,perl=TRUE)
 z <- xml2::read_xml(t)
 for(n in xml2::xml_find_all(z,"//*[@class]")) xml2::xml_set_attr(n,"class",paste0(prefix,strsplit(xml2::xml_attr(n,"class")," ")[[1]],collapse=" "))
 ids <- xml2::xml_attr(xml2::xml_find_all(z,"//*[@id]"),"id")
 t <- as.character(z)
 for(id in ids) { t <- gsub(paste0('id="',id,'"'),paste0('id="',prefix,id,'"'),t,fixed=TRUE); t <- gsub(paste0("url(#",id,")"),paste0("url(#",prefix,id,")"),t,fixed=TRUE) }
 xml2::read_xml(t)
}
s <- xml2::read_xml('<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 2000 1250"><rect width="2000" height="1250" fill="white"/></svg>')
files <- c("experimental_setup_reactor.svg","experimental_setup_cleaning-event.svg","experimental_setup_sampling-design.svg","experimental_setup_tmp.svg")
pos <- data.frame(x=c(30,900,30,910),y=c(55,55,550,550),w=c(830,1070,840,1070),h=c(311,447,374,663))
for(i in 1:4) {
 p <- scope(xml2::read_xml(file.path(base,files[i])),paste0("p",i,"-"))
 for(a in c("x","y","width","height")) xml2::xml_set_attr(xml2::xml_root(p),a,as.character(c(x=pos$x[i],y=pos$y[i],width=pos$w[i],height=pos$h[i])[[a]]))
 xml2::xml_add_child(xml2::xml_root(s),xml2::xml_root(p))
 xml2::xml_add_child(xml2::xml_root(s),xml2::xml_root(xml2::read_xml(sprintf('<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="%d" y="%d" font-family="Arial" font-size="24">%s</text>',pos$x[i],pos$y[i]-18,LETTERS[i]))))
}
xml2::write_xml(s,file.path(out,"FigureS1-original-experiment.svg"))
python <- "/tmp/phage-workflow-svg-render-20260915/bin/python"
for(stem in c("Figure1-analytical-workflow","FigureS1-original-experiment")) {
 p <- normalizePath(file.path(out,paste0(stem,".svg")))
 code <- sprintf("import cairosvg; cairosvg.svg2png(url=%s,write_to=%s,scale=1.5); cairosvg.svg2pdf(url=%s,write_to=%s)",dQuote(p,FALSE),dQuote(sub("svg$","png",p),FALSE),dQuote(p,FALSE),dQuote(sub("svg$","pdf",p),FALSE))
 stopifnot(system2(python,c("-c",shQuote(code)),env="DYLD_FALLBACK_LIBRARY_PATH=/opt/homebrew/lib")==0)
}
inputs <- file.path(base,c(files,"workflow_metro.svg"))
write.table(data.frame(file=inputs,md5=unname(tools::md5sum(inputs))),file.path(out,"input_checksums.tsv"),sep="\t",quote=FALSE,row.names=FALSE)
writeLines(c("Existing sources reused; no route changes, extensions or statistical refits.","Main Figure 1 is analytical only. Original experiment is explicitly Supplementary Figure 1.","SVG and PDF preserve vectors; original TMP panel remains embedded source-poster raster.","Individual panel CSS and IDs scoped to prevent cross-panel style collisions.","Downstream modelling routes intentionally not added in this revision."),file.path(out,"VALIDATION.txt"))
```
